description: facade of a Bronze Age Greek megaron hall seen from directly in front, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Long low building of warm pale limestone ashlar blocks with a FLAT roof slab and a straight parapet across the top. A row of six plain stone columns stands along the front supporting a plain horizontal lintel beam, with a tall wooden double door of vertical planks at the centre and small square windows between the columns. The whole facade is drawn small enough that the left end and the right end are both complete and visible. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the building.
